Class TT_PCLT

java.lang.Object
org.lwjgl.system.Pointer.Default
org.lwjgl.system.Struct<TT_PCLT>
org.lwjgl.util.freetype.TT_PCLT
All Implemented Interfaces:
Pointer
public class TT_PCLT extends Struct<TT_PCLT>
struct TT_PCLT {
    FT_Fixed Version;
    FT_ULong FontNumber;
    FT_UShort Pitch;
    FT_UShort xHeight;
    FT_UShort Style;
    FT_UShort TypeFamily;
    FT_UShort CapHeight;
    FT_UShort SymbolSet;
    FT_Char TypeFace[16];
    FT_Char CharacterComplement[8];
    FT_Char FileName[6];
    FT_Char StrokeWeight;
    FT_Char WidthType;
    FT_Byte SerifStyle;
    FT_Byte Reserved;
}

  • Constructor Details

    • TT_PCLT

      public TT_PCLT(ByteBuffer container)
      Creates a TT_PCLT instance at the current position of the specified ByteBuffer container. Changes to the buffer's content will be visible to the struct instance and vice versa.

      The created instance holds a strong reference to the container object.
